findings.note_span: Flucloxacillin 500 mg once daily for 7 days, on an empty stomach.
findings.transcript_evidence: I'll prescribe flucloxacillin, 500 milligrams four times a day for seven days. Take it on an empty stomach, an hour before food or two hours after.
findings.rationale: The note incorrectly states the antibiotic should be taken once daily, while the transcript indicates a frequency of four times a day.
